title: Annual Fire Extinguisher Inspection
standard: Saskatchewan fire code (National Fire Code adoption) and the portable extinguisher standard it references. DRAFT: confirm edition and wording before publishing.

onNo.suggestedDescription: Not all areas were accessible during the inspection. Areas not inspected: [list]. Follow-up visit required.

questions.text: All pressurized dry chemical fire extinguishers manufactured after 1984?

onNo.suggestedDescription: Dry chemical extinguisher(s) manufactured in or before 1984 found in service. Remove from service and replace.
CO2 extinguisher(s) manufactured in or before 1955 found in service. Remove from service and replace.

questions.text: Are the fire extinguishers of the correct classification for all areas of the building?

onNo.suggestedDescription: Extinguisher classification does not match the hazard in: [area]. Recommend: [type].

questions.text: All recalled fire extinguishers have been removed from service

onNo.suggestedDescription: Recalled fire extinguisher(s) found in service. Unit identified for removal and replacement.

questions.text: Is the maximum travel distance of 75 feet maintained throughout?

onNo.suggestedDescription: Travel distance to an extinguisher exceeds the maximum in: [area]. Additional extinguisher required.

onFail.suggestedDescription: Extinguisher pressure out of operable range. Recharge or replace.

deviceChecks.text: Safety pin and tamper seal intact
Hose and nozzle in good condition and unobstructed
No physical damage, corrosion or leakage

onFail.suggestedDescription: Extinguisher shows damage, corrosion or leakage. Remove from service and replace.

deviceChecks.text: Operating instructions legible and facing outward
6-year maintenance and hydrostatic test not overdue

onFail.suggestedDescription: Extinguisher overdue for 6-year maintenance or hydrostatic test.
